construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory

input.synthetic: Required true; all assets, users and maintenance logs are fictitious
input.work_orders: ERP/MES-style objects: id, asset_id, title, metric, unit, tolerance_min/max, safety_min/max, created_at, due_at, invented maintenance_log
input.telemetry_csv: Embedded time-series CSV with exact header reading_id,work_order_id,asset_id,timestamp,metric,value,unit
input.quality_inspections: Objects: id, work_order_id, decision pass/fail, decision_by, reason, timestamp, nonempty source_reading_ids
input.events: Objects: id, user_id, work_order_id, action browse/purchase, timestamp; purchase is synthetic work-order-associated procurement activity

shared_schema.output: JSON envelope with schema_version, status, synthetic, as_of, user_id, mode, rankings, alerts, total_candidates and disclaimer; errors contain schema_version, status:error and error
shared_schema.validation: Single validate function handles all entities, uniqueness, links, chronology, supported units, finite physical ranges, ordered nested tolerances and evidence-consistent decisions
shared_schema.traceability: Each quality decision retains responsible person, rationale, timestamp, work-order link and source reading IDs. This is a demonstrative ISO 9001-oriented traceability rule, not certification.

cross_stage_handoffs: One stage only: validated orders, readings, inspections and events feed behavioral discovery.
Discovery produces ranked work-order references, quality audit traces and independent complete safety escalation records.

behavior.scoring: Sum action_weight * affinity * 2^(-age_days/half_life_days); browse=1, purchase=3; affinity exact order=1, otherwise same asset=0.4, otherwise same metric=0.2, otherwise=0
behavior.ordering: Safety-flagged orders first, then descending unrounded score, ascending due date, lexical order ID; display scores rounded to 8 decimals
behavior.cold_start: No events for requested user: all scores zero, safety first then earliest due date then ID; other users' events do not personalize
behavior.quality: Inclusive operating tolerances; pass iff every linked reading is within tolerance. Uninspected orders explicitly labeled. All quality decisions preserved; latest timestamp then ID determines displayed status.
behavior.safety: Every reading outside inclusive safety bounds creates pending human-review alert; no automated machine actuation or actual notification. Historical unsafe readings remain flagged. Alerts are not truncated by ranking limit.
behavior.fixtures: Explicitly synthetic example; test uses random.Random(133) for 25 reproducible physically plausible temperature, pressure and vibration telemetry samples
behavior.determinism: No wall-clock access in ranking, no stochastic production logic, no provider, no LLM

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object with status ok, personalized ranking and human escalation
coverage: CLI success, file, schema and usage errors
